title: Select the Step 7 declaration on the native training command line
summary: Native training packs and scripts/train.py accept --randomization none|table2_v1 and pass it to the native environment. The run identity and PACK.json record the declaration name, hash and canonical ranges; a nominal run records no randomization key, so its identity is unchanged. Evaluation, probes and diagnostics refuse a declaration and run the nominal robot; an evaluation records the checkpoint's declaration. The physics identity and standing admission are those of the nominal robot. No Isaac run has exercised this code.
next: Push the branch and open the Step 7 native PR; native validation in Isaac waits on program-lead dispatch and admission.
reason: A command-line option only: no native run, admission result, gate threshold or accepted capability changes.
